hooks.command: jq -r '[.tool_input.file_path // "", .tool_input.new_string // "", .tool_input.content // ""] | @tsv' | awk -F'	' '$1 ~ /\.claude\/settings(\.local)?\.json$/ && ($2 ~ /allow/ || $3 ~ /allow/) {print; exit}' | grep -q . && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: Claude is not allowed to add allow permissions to .claude/settings.json"}}' || true

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); echo "$cmd" | grep -q '\.claude/settings.*\.json' && echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'allow' && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: Claude is not allowed to modify allow permissions in .claude/settings.json"}}' || true
